title: limnophila balsamea var. thorelii
intro: Limnophila balsamea var. thorelii, commonly known as Thorelia, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The bioactive constituents of Limnophila balsamea var. thorelii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand its therapeutic effects and potential applications.
